en.text:
Elemental Kills grant 1 Stack of Recombination even while the weapon is stowed. Maximum of #e${10/#d} stacks.

Each Stack additively increases the damage of the next shot by <pve #e${10*#d}% /> <pvp [#e${5*#d}%] />, up to <pve 100% /> <pvp [50%] /> at ${10/#d} stacks.

enhanced (
var d = 1.25
#e Damage Buff ramps up 25% faster, reaching maximum strength 2 stacks sooner.
)
